# PLAN — iteration 5

## Current state assessment

Iteration 4 is the verified incumbent, with timing closed at WNS 0.148 ns and WHS 0.182 ns; it used a carry-save reduction for the default coefficients. The objective is now to improve register-to-register setup slack over 0.148 ns at the same 6.667 ns clock period, while preserving the one-cycle registered FIR behavior and passing simulation, latency, tool, routed-report, metric-integrity, setup, and hold gates. The top must retain `// @latency 1`.

## Hypothesis

For the exact default coefficients, narrowing the registered partial sums to 23 bits should shorten carry propagation and reduce FF use while preserving the full-precision 32-bit output value.

## Instruction for generator

In the exact-default-coefficients specialization, change the 32-bit `acc` partial-sum registers and associated sum expressions to signed 23-bit values; sign-extend the final sum into the existing 32-bit `y_out`. Keep the general parameterized fallback unchanged, along with the delay register, synchronous active-high reset, registered output, and `// @latency 1`. The default-coefficient bound is a signed sum of at most 80 products of signed 16-bit samples, which fits in 23 bits; confirm the fixed testbench and all mandatory routed timing and metric gates before promotion.
